strategies.name: Nifty PE Gap-Down Breakout 80 Target - delayed trail, failed-breakdown exit, 40pt stop cap2 - skip THU
strategies.description: Trades only when NIFTY opens >= 0.2% and < 2% below the previous close. PE only, max 1 trade/day. Ref candle 09:15-09:20 IST; buy PE at ATM+50 on a fresh 5-min close below refLow, on 5-min candles starting before 14:00 IST. Initial SL = closer of (refHigh+refLow)/2 and entry + 40 points, held until spot is 20 points below entry; then SL moves to entry - 5 (locks 5 points) and trails on completed 5-min block highs (min(SL, high)). Before that, exit at the close of any 5-min candle that closes above refLow + 10 (failed breakdown). Target -80 spot points. EOD square-off 15:20. No trading on Thursdays (skipDays). Backtest deducts Rs 85 charges per trade.

strategies.name: Nifty CE Gap-Up Breakout 80 Target - delayed trail, no entry after 14:00, gap < 2% - skip THU
strategies.description: Trades only when NIFTY opens >= 0.2% and < 2% above the previous close. CE only, max 1 trade/day. Ref candle 09:15-09:20 IST; buy CE at ATM-50 on a fresh 5-min close above refHigh, on 5-min candles starting before 14:00 IST. Initial SL = (refHigh+refLow)/2, held until spot is +20 points above entry; then SL moves to entry and trails on completed 5-min block lows (max(SL, low)). Target +80 spot points. EOD square-off 15:20. No trading on Thursdays (skipDays). Backtest deducts Rs 85 charges per trade.
